name: Claudia
source:
A fairy named Vivace brings chaos into Nak’s life. His adoption is a nightmare, and only Claudia saves him from despair.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=31394]Lemmasoft forum[/url]]
translation:
一位名叫Vivace的仙女给Nak的生活带来了混乱。他的收养是一场噩梦，只有克劳迪娅将他从绝望中拯救出来。

[来自[url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=31394]Lemmasoft论坛[/url]]
